name: mock-lab smart replace (token + order_id)
description: Chains the two moving IDs on replay: access_token from POST /oauth/token into the Authorization header, and order_id from POST /api/orders into the GET /api/orders/{id} path. Filters deliberately omit network_address: replay rewrites the address to the --test-against target, so a network_address filter binds the blueprint to one spelling of the target and fires nothing against any other (measured: 'localhost' fires, '127.0.0.1' loads and fires nothing). detectedLocation alone is unambiguous here -- these paths exist only in the inbound localhost traffic.
